Prior single-column quote reconstructions failed literal matching against the two-column layout of the source file; the literal contiguous source passage is preserved above.

decisions.reason: Both the shipped record and blind coding correctly classify the replication outcome for Runeson et al. (2007) [7] as 'mixed'. No single overall verdict covers the replication as a whole; instead, the authors report confirming the original study's finding on RQ2 (up-weighting the defect title relative to the description improves duplicate detection accuracy, ExpA) while explicitly failing to confirm and presenting conflicting evidence against the original study's finding on RQ3 (filtering candidate duplicates by submission date window is not beneficial, ExpB). Note that the shipped quote only mentioned the 3x title weight on RQ2, whereas the mixed outcome derives from RQ2 confirming and RQ3 conflicting with the original study.
